required_artifact: signed FEMA IPAWS COG/MOA or authorized surrogate
minimum_fields: COG id; authority scope; responsible official; effective date; expiration/review date
risk_if_missing: alert may be sent by an unauthorized or wrong-scope actor

required_artifact: IPAWS public alerting authority permission packet
minimum_fields: event types; geographic warning area; channels; test/exercise/live scope
risk_if_missing: alert can appear in archive but exceed approved scope

required_artifact: active originator account roster and revocation log
minimum_fields: user id surrogate; role; MFA/certificate state; last review; backup originator
risk_if_missing: orphaned or stale account can originate unreconciled alert

minimum_fields: decision authority; reviewer; timestamps; message id; exception path
risk_if_missing: single-user draft can be mistaken for approved protective action

required_artifact: IPAWS-compatible software config and certificate check
minimum_fields: software; certificate expiration; endpoint; test success; error log
risk_if_missing: credential failure or wrong endpoint can suppress delivery

required_artifact: exercise/test flag and live-channel suppression proof
minimum_fields: status; scope; message type; dissemination channels; MSEL reference
risk_if_missing: exercise message can leak as live or live path can be mis-tested

required_artifact: template hash, version, and approved text bundle
minimum_fields: template id; hash; language variants; expiry; CAP field mapping

required_artifact: protective-action decision log tied to alert payload
minimum_fields: PAD/PAR id; authority; ECL; KI/evacuation/shelter action; affected zones
risk_if_missing: message may not match protective-action decision
tri-state message can omit or contradict a jurisdiction

required_artifact: public message accessibility and language review packet
minimum_fields: language list; plain-language check; accessibility channel; reviewer
risk_if_missing: alert can reach only English or non-accessible audiences

minimum_fields: agriculture authority; public-health authority; hold/release language; KI conflict check
risk_if_missing: producer instructions can conflict with KI or evacuation message

required_artifact: school and access/functional-needs protective-action approval log
minimum_fields: school districts; transport/AFN authority; shelter/evac instruction; parent/guardian line
risk_if_missing: school or AFN instructions can conflict with public alert

required_artifact: device clock proof across originator, IPAWS, EAS/WEA, JIC, evaluator logs
minimum_fields: NTP source; clock offset; time zone; correction; custody event
risk_if_missing: sequence of warning, correction, and cancel cannot be trusted

required_artifact: exercise-controller inject authorization and deviation log
minimum_fields: inject id; actual inject time; controller; deviation; evaluator notification
risk_if_missing: exercise evidence can be misread without actual inject timing

minimum_fields: backup site; user; software; last test; failover threshold
risk_if_missing: primary outage can silently cap alert readiness

required_artifact: account/certificate freeze and post-exercise export plan
minimum_fields: revocation date; custody export; hash; sensitive-annex route
risk_if_missing: post-exercise mutation or deletion can corrupt evidence

required_artifact: speaker/role roster for preliminary findings meeting
minimum_fields: speaker; agency; scope; statement class; recording/transcript link
risk_if_missing: public meeting remark can be mistaken for final AAR closure

required_artifact: named independent verifier and conflict check
minimum_fields: verifier; independence basis; evidence scope; redaction review
risk_if_missing: self-attested alert success can close nothing safely
